subject.title: fix(linux): always surface manual update results

question: Should this protected Linux desktop PR require direct Linux notification proof before merge, or should maintainers explicitly accept the stated environment-limited proof gap?
rationale: The code changes a user-visible delivery guarantee, while the author confirms the final OS-notification path was not observed after the change.

options.title: Require Linux desktop proof
options.body: Capture a redacted real update-check result from a remote or tray-closed main window before merging.

options.title: Accept the bounded proof gap
options.body: Merge based on the policy tests and existing notification mechanism while accepting that OS delivery was not demonstrated on this branch.

recommendation.title: Require Linux desktop proof
recommendation.body: Capture a redacted real update-check result from a remote or tray-closed main window before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the proposed policy and can best provide or explain the missing Linux runtime evidence.
